en: Colorized vintage postcard depicting a large, two-story neoclassical building with arched windows and a central entrance portico. The structure is surrounded by trees and a wooden fence in the foreground. People, likely students, are visible in front of the building and looking out from the windows. Text in Cyrillic and Latin script appears in the top left corner naming the institution as a girls' gymnasium in Stara Zagora.
